design_philosophy: High-density, tactical terminal designed for fast-paced scalping and grid trading. Focus on data visibility, zero-latency feel, and professional grade aesthetics. 'Intelligent density'—show more information but keep the hierarchy clear.

headings.instruction: Use Cabinet Grotesk for all module titles, panel headers, and stats cards. Use 'tracking-tight' for a sharp, technical look. NO INTER for headers.

body.instruction: Clean, highly legible body text for labels and general UI.

numbers.instruction: MANDATORY for all numerical values: PnL, Prices, Percentages, Timestamps, Quantities. Add 'tabular-nums' class to all numerical spans to prevent width jitter during live updates.

layouts.description: Dense layout utilizing almost 100% of the screen real-estate. Zero dead space. Grid borders exposed.
layouts.container: min-h-screen bg-[#09090b] text-white flex flex-col font-sans

structure.top_nav: h-14 border-b border-white/10 flex items-center justify-between px-4 bg-[#121214]
structure.ticker_strip: h-10 border-b border-white/5 bg-[#09090b] flex items-center overflow-hidden text-xs font-mono
structure.main_workspace: flex-1 grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-4 p-4
structure.chart_panel: col-span-1 lg:col-span-8 flex flex-col rounded-sm border border-white/10 bg-[#121214] overflow-hidden
structure.control_panel: col-span-1 lg:col-span-4 flex flex-col rounded-sm border border-white/10 bg-[#121214] overflow-hidden
structure.stats_cards: col-span-1 lg:col-span-12 grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4
structure.bottom_panel: col-span-1 lg:col-span-8 flex flex-col rounded-sm border border-white/10 bg-[#121214] overflow-hidden h-96
structure.activity_log: col-span-1 lg:col-span-4 flex flex-col rounded-sm border border-white/10 bg-[#121214] overflow-hidden h-96

components_instructions.cards: Cardless or 'Technical Look' with visible grid borders. Sharp corners (`rounded-none` or max `rounded-sm`). 1px solid stroke (`border-white/10`). Never use generic soft shadows; use `shadow-none`.
components_instructions.tables: High density, text-xs. Use Shadcn Table. Numbers must be right-aligned using tabular-nums. Use sticky headers.
components_instructions.buttons: Sharp, rectangular (`rounded-sm`). High contrast hover states. Electric cyan (`bg-[#00F0FF] text-black`) for the main 'Start Bot' CTA. Red (`bg-red-500 text-white`) for 'Stop/Kill Switch'.
components_instructions.inputs: Shadcn Form/Input. Dark background (`bg-[#09090b]`), 1px border. Focus state must glow with primary accent (`focus-visible:ring-[#00F0FF]/50`).
components_instructions.tabs: Shadcn Tabs. Override `h-9` to `h-auto`. Use technical style: transparent background, active state has a bright cyan bottom border.
components_instructions.charts: Use Recharts for Equity Curve/PnL chart. Use a dark theme palette for the chart tooltip. For candlesticks, use an Area Chart in Recharts to mock the look if TradingView Lightweight Charts is unavailable.
components_instructions.indicators: Use pill badges (`rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] uppercase font-mono`) to show RSI/MACD states.

visual_enhancers.glow_effects: Use subtle `drop-shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(0,240,255,0.4)]` for the active 'Bot Running' pulse indicator.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: DO NOT USE. Medical/Financial apps require Flat Solid surfaces to prevent visual refraction of data. Use `#121214` solid background.
visual_enhancers.textures: Add a very faint repeating linear gradient or dotted background pattern (`bg-grid-white/[0.02]`) to empty areas to maintain the terminal aesthetic.

motion.micro_interactions: Fast, precise. 150ms transitions. Button hover should feel immediate.
motion.data_updates: Framer Motion layout animations for the activity log (new logs slide down from top). Flash green/red briefly when prices update.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 ratio. Muted text should not be darker than `#71717a` against `#121214`.
accessibility.focus: Clear focus rings on all inputs.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You MUST use JetBrains Mono or Roboto Mono for all financial numbers and percentages.
You MUST apply 'tabular-nums' class to all numerical spans to prevent width jitter.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Trading terminals are full-width, left-aligned.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
Include a `data-testid` on all key UI elements (buttons, inputs, tabs, table rows).
Use Phosphor Icons or Lucide React for crisp, technical icons.
The UI text MUST be in Turkish as per user request. Do not leave English placeholder text for content.
Ensure dark mode is fully enforced, with no unreadable low-contrast text.
Do not use transparent backgrounds for dropdowns or modals.
libraries_to_install: yarn add recharts @phosphor-icons/react clsx tailwind-merge framer-motion sonner lucide-react
